summary: Live view tiles fail fast for offline cameras: when the health monitor reports a camera offline, the tile shows an 'Offline' placeholder immediately instead of hanging on WebRTC/MJPEG timeouts against the dead RTSP stream, and auto-recovers to live when health flips back online
compatibility: Frontend-only. Uses the existing per-camera health status (refreshed every 15s and on the notification SSE stream); no backend change.
